summary: Fixes a genuine E8 clean-machine failure: stock Ubuntu's root-owned /opt made 20-application.sh's unprivileged `git clone /opt/isadoraair` fail before creating the work tree. Stage 20 now privileges only the target-directory establishment (new --owner flag, mirroring 40-station-content.sh's existing convention) before cloning as the ordinary operator; --staging-root unaffected. README.md install docs fixed to match. No migrations, package, runtime, or service changes.
